name: Youxi Zhai yu Qingchun Nü
source:
This is a visual novel, a casual game centered on experiencing the heartfelt story of a youthful romantic comedy.  It tells the story of an otaku and a bubbly girl creating a game together. Playing from a first-person perspective, you’ll stand side by side with Feiqiao through every step: from launching a campus crowdfunding campaign to weathering a public opinion storm, working together to bring your romantic game to life and write your shared future into the true ending.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4105970]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一款视觉小说，一款以体验青春浪漫喜剧的真情故事为中心的休闲游戏。它讲述了一个御宅族和一个活泼的女孩一起创造游戏的故事。以第一人称视角进行游戏，你将与飞桥并肩走过每一步：从发起校园众筹活动到经受舆论风暴，共同努力将你们的浪漫游戏变成现实，将你们共同的未来写成真正的结局。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4105970]Steam[/url]]
